Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning dues paid to the Washington public ports association by port districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to dues for an association established under RCW53.06.030; and amending RCW 53.06.040.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 53.06.040 and 1973 1st ex.s. c 195 s 55 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each port district which designates the Washington public portsassociation as the agency through which the duties imposed by RCW53.06.020 may be executed is authorized to pay dues and/or assessmentsto said association from port district funds in any calendar year ((inan amount not exceeding a sum equal to the amount which would be raisedby a levy of one cent per thousand dollars of assessed value againstthe taxable property within the port district)).
